Pretentious European with great architecture
Jun 2026 • Solo
I guess every city needs one… a space that is architecturally beautiful and with so much potential yet the staff is so not tentative. Most were super young. They did gather together to spin spoons and catch up. As a new customer, I caught them off guard by walking in. Then it was pointing to where I could sit. Once I got to the third floor, no one HABE me a menu or asked it they could take my order. I waved my hands and the young waitress assigned to my floor tried her best to explain something but ended up calling someone else maybe six months older than her. He was clear that I was supposed to order before someone pointed to me where I was to sit. Oh, I must go back to first floor to order when I already know what I want? Can you kindly take my order sir. He had to go back down to get permission to take my order but warned, the next time…he said because we’re so busy. It made me feel like I was super lucky. The food was ok for a rule breaking quest I looked around knowing I would never go back because as long as I can remember, hospitality was about being served with attentiveness and making the experience for the customer memorable—in a pleasant way! It might come in time after they lose the pretentiousness!!!

Surprising organization. Ordering while standing, paying in advance. Takes some getting used to.
Dec 2025 • Solo
At first, I was put off. You have to place your order standing at the bar and only then sit down at a table of your choice. They don't have beer, only wine. If you want to order more, you have to get up from your seat on the first or second floor, go to the bar, order again, and pay. So much for what I consider an unfriendly service. The food itself was very good. I ordered two salads, one with chicken and the other hummus with salad, as well as two fried eggs and chili. Everything was very good, and because I didn't feel like walking around a restaurant with a full stomach to reorder, I ordered two Merlots right from the start. It's an unusual place, like a stylish old factory hall with Wi-Fi booths/offices for digital nomads... A great idea. The coffee and espresso are affordable. I don't know what rating to give. In dubio pro reo.
